scope: Synthetic loopback HTTP fixture and staging gate checks. No deployed application or guest scenario selected.
The source commit identifies the checkout base, with Phase 1 runner changes applied locally.

tests.expected: Fresh guest entry and refresh reach usable discovery controls and load app assets.
Explore Pretoria, zoom, and open a marker whose details match the selection.
Category and date filters agree across map and calendar, and reset restores results.
Open a public search result, recover after a nonsense query and repeat discovery.
Open a public event or place and reopen the same item from its copied URL.
Keyboard and narrow layouts have visible focus, reachable controls and recoverable panels.
An isolated synthetic citizen can join and cancel, and a synthetic contributor can create a draft. Cleanup is verified.
Android release candidate passes native launch, back, permission, deep link, share, auth, offline recovery and notification checks on emulator and hardware.

findings.user_impact: Guest discovery controls required refresh in one observed session.
findings.proposed_fix: Reproduce and diagnose the guest initialization path in a fresh session before changing it.
findings.design_guidance: Show loading and keyboard-accessible recovery. Preserve a clear route to discovery and service.
acceptance_checks: Fresh desktop and narrow guest sessions reach usable controls on first entry.
Refresh restores the same guest route.
Any stalled load gives actionable recovery feedback.
findings.observation: One desktop Chrome guest transition produced a blank cream screen with an empty accessibility tree. One refresh restored guest controls. Frequency, root cause and narrow-viewport impact are unknown.
